description: This file implements CUDA-specific scaled matrix multiplication and tensor scaling checks within the PyTorch ATen library. It defines various functions to verify tensor scaling recipes (e.g., tensorwise, rowwise, blockwise) for quantized FP8 and FP4 types, facilitating optimized CUDA kernel selection for scaled GEMM operations.

methods.name: bool check_tensorwise_recipe(c10::ScalarType type_a,std::vector<ScalingType> & recipe_a,ArrayRef<Tensor> & scales_a,c10::ScalarType type_b,std::vector<ScalingType> & recipe_b,ArrayRef<Tensor> & scales_b)
methods.description: Verifies if given tensor types, scaling recipes, and scales conform to a tensor-wise scaling recipe for FP8 types.

methods.description: Verifies if given tensor types, scaling recipes, and scales conform to a row-wise scaling recipe for FP8 types.

methods.description: Checks whether the input tensors and recipes match the NVFP4 scaling pattern with specific scaling types.

methods.description: Checks whether the recipe corresponds to single-scale NVFP4 scaling.
